name: Akechi Mitsuhide
source:
Hobby: Tea Ceremony
Special Skill: Guns
Charm Point: His resolute eyelashes

Nobunaga's right-hand man, a warrior shrouded in mystery. Hideyoshi actively distrusts him, and some say he has been meeting the enemy in secret. While he is aware of these rumours, he doesn't appear to care.

"Don't lie. I know you like it when I tease you."

[from the app]
